data.summary:
* Added pure `classifyAttempt` (workers/orchestrator/src/services/task-dispatcher/classify-attempt.ts) that short-circuits the completion verifier on infra-layer failures (container exit before `[claude] Session init`, empty transcript, sub-5s duration) and returns a sub-reason + first error line.
  * Wired the classifier into task-dispatcher so infra-failed attempts finalize with a new `WORKER_INFRA_FAILURE` TaskError instead of the misleading `TASK_COMPLETION_VERIFICATION_FAILED: Missing fields: memory_ids_used, memory_ids_rejected`.
  * Added `taskInfraFailureHistory` with typed `InfraFailureSubReason` union; on repeat sub-reason across a user-driven resume the remediation flips from `retry` to `contact_support` (advisory — code-agent's classifyFailure returns `'fail'` unconditionally so the auto-retry loop stops, mirroring the existing `WORKTREE_LOST` terminal path).
  * Tested via 9 classifier unit cases, 3 integration scenarios (exit=128 finalizes as WORKER_INFRA_FAILURE, verifier never called, repeat sub-reason flips remediation + passes through a TaskResult), and 2 classifyFailure terminal-branch tests; adjusted existing fixtures to include `[claude]` prefix so the verifier path is still exercised.
  * CI green (`pnpm run ci:tracked` — 15510 tests passed, 100% branch coverage maintained) and PR #1913 opened against development after 2 clean code-review iterations.
